reasons.decided: arm.py is a .py file, read as a part (parametric)

steps.headline: First ply failure at 5.17x the load, target 1.5. Ply 1 at 0 degrees goes first by Tsai-Wu at (37.5, -1.97e-04, 12) mm, and Hashin gives 8.88x by fiber compression. Confidence is medium.
